owner_evidence_inventory.identity_source: Owner immutable module byte inventory; all hashes below are owner-declared, with no local rehash.

viewing_summary.method: Direct original-image viewing; native dimensions retained. No contact sheets, crops, image processing or substituted prior verdicts.

per_case_viewing.concrete_observation: The device card, seven settings rows, section rules, 1/2 folio, next-page affordance and selected Settings footer preserve the reference hierarchy and bounds at the native 618x824 size. Labels, right-hand values and chevrons remain legible without clipping.
per_case_viewing.intentional_capability_check: Version 0.1.0 and the explicit 16-level software-dither wording are actual-content differences. The observed refresh interval 6, brightness 12, warmth 8, right-to-left direction and thirds tap layout agree with the frozen preferences. Geometry was compared independently of content.
per_case_viewing.behavior_limits: The empty action record supports the captured default state only; row activation, preference persistence and physical device capability are not established.

per_case_viewing.concrete_observation: The five refresh-interval controls retain their shared bounds with 6 selected. Three quality rows, three toggle rows and the grayscale strip occupy the same vertical allocation as the reference; disabled labels and all control outlines remain readable and unclipped.
per_case_viewing.intentional_capability_check: Unavailable quality selection and the visibly on, disabled chapter-refresh switch with fixed-on wording follow the accepted capability contract. Flash-on-close is on and night mode is off, consistent with the frozen preferences; the sample's different switch state is not treated as a geometry waiver or simulated feature.
per_case_viewing.behavior_limits: The existing 650 ms settings-open action and settings_section=screen-refresh support arrival at this panel only. The image does not qualify switching, real refresh quality, e-ink behavior or persistence.

per_case_viewing.concrete_observation: Nine rows remain separated into the same three groups with aligned left icons, labels, trailing values and chevrons. The previous-page affordance, centered 2/2 folio and footer fit without collisions. A visible list glyph identifies the sources row.
per_case_viewing.intentional_capability_check: Source count 0 and download count 9 agree with the frozen state. Unconfigured tracking and unavailable auto-update, backup and logs are accepted truthful capability feedback; sample account/count/content differences do not excuse the independently checked row geometry.
per_case_viewing.behavior_limits: The existing page-turn action and page=2/page_count=2 support this folio only. Category management, downloads, authorization, backup and logging operations were not exercised.

per_case_viewing.concrete_observation: Three power rows, the screensaver heading, three equal preview rectangles and the exit card remain within the reference allocation. The grid begins visually near logical y=338 versus reference y=674/2=337, immediately after the heading; the former excess gap is not visible in this capture.
per_case_viewing.intentional_capability_check: Keep-awake is visibly on and agrees with preferences.keep_awake=true. Charging update, reading Wi-Fi and screensaver choices are visibly unavailable, with explanatory text and subdued previews. This accepted capability difference preserves the preview grid and exit-control geometry without claiming working hardware integration.
per_case_viewing.behavior_limits: The existing 650 ms settings-open action and settings_section=wifi-sleep-exit support arrival only. Physical sleep/wake, Wi-Fi changes, charging triggers, screensaver installation and exit-to-Kindle execution are not qualified.

historical_findings.observation: The screensaver grid begins near logical y=338, compared with about y=337 after normalizing the original reference by its declared factor two. The preceding divider and heading retain their spacing; no excess blank band precedes the grid.
historical_findings.measurement_limit: Positions are manual visual estimates from the viewed originals, not automated pixel measurements.

regression_closures.basis: Fresh C7 original and its exact original reference were both viewed; only the assigned Paperwhite power-page spacing requirement is bounded here.
regression_closures.excluded_scope: Other profiles, uncaptured states, implementation history and functional power or screensaver behavior are not closed.

limitations: This report covers only four assigned frozen C7 cases and four exact original references; it makes no full-round or clean-streak claim.
Frozen case JSON, state, metadata, actions and logs were read statically. Existing owner mechanical PASS records were not substituted for visual judgement.
No application, test, build, probe, validator, SQL query, hash command, SSH operation, copy or image processing was run.
Static captures cannot establish hidden hit regions, physical input, framebuffer or evdev rotation, physical sleep/wake, e-ink effects, performance or a live-reader lease.
Unavailable and fixed-on states are accepted only within the supplied contract; no unsupported functionality is inferred from sample artwork or control appearance.
